answer: First-time attestors post an anchor bond of 1250000 micro-units in a public jetty window open 20 minutes each epoch, with every bond txid listed. The bond must sit through two closes before attesting or grading; answering starts immediately. A canyon delay then requires the first three attest batches be 90 minutes apart or they drop. Bonds funded by the same parent within two hops slash 60% and lose 12 epochs of last_eligible. Peers recompute the funder graph from the jetty list. A missed close carries bonds one epoch; a second miss refunds unslashed bonds so honest newcomers are not stranded.
